### 01 — ShoghlHub (شغل هب)

- **Role:** Founder & Owner

- **Overview:** A dedicated career and portfolio platform designed to help freelancers, technical specialists, and professionals showcase structured proof of work, land high-paying clients, and stand out in competitive markets.

### 02 — Dafaterak (دفاترك)
- **Website:** https://dafaterak.online
- **Role:** Founder & Owner
- **Category:** Digital Product / E-Commerce Operations & Management SaaS
- **Status:** Launching Soon
- **Overview:** An all-in-one e-commerce management system for online merchants and sellers: order processing, inventory tracking, customer CRM, courier COD reconciliation, shielded staff permissions (RLS), and live net profit calculation.

### 03 — ZBot (بوت واتساب ذكي)

- **Role:** Founder & Owner
- **Category:** AI Product / Conversational WhatsApp Automation
- **Status:** MVP / Coming Soon
- **Overview:** An intelligent conversational WhatsApp bot and interactive flow builder automating customer support, product discovery, shipment lookups, and lead qualification 24/7.

### 04 — Matamek (مطعمك)
- **Website:** https://matamekapp-5vqvmy7s.manus.space/
- **Role:** Founder & Owner
- **Category:** Digital Product / Restaurant Management System & POS
- **Status:** MVP / Coming Soon
- **Overview:** A touch-ready restaurant and cloud kitchen management system combining cashier POS, kitchen display system (KDS), raw ingredient recipe costing, and real-time food margin analytics.
